# Nineteen

"Mrs. Ferrante says you've been down at the creek," he said. "Dr. Bell
saw you Tuesday. So did Mr. Sabatini, and Mr. Sabatini talks."

She turned the cup around on the saucer. "Then he told you wrong."

"He told me you were alone."

"That part he told you right." {>>her three-beat rhythm; keep it<<}

St. Helena was eleven miles and she had walked it before. He knew that
too, and did not say so.
